fields.summary_ko.0: Mizuho raised Amazon (NASDAQ:AMZN) target price to $335 from $330 while maintaining Outperform rating, suggesting AWS capable of achieving 40% annual earnings growth over the next two years.
fields.summary_ko.1: Amazon planning approximately $22 billion in capital expenditure this year with increases expected by 2027, with AI inference demand and open-source model adoption serving as growth drivers.
